# Song of Solomon Chapter 4 -- Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-12

This log records all verses in Song of Solomon Chapter 4 where the three translators significantly diverged.

---

## 4:9 — "captivated" vs. "ravished" vs. "stolen"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "You-have-ravished my-heart" | *libbavtini* = to heart/ravish |
| LOGOS | "You have captivated my heart" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "You have stolen my heart" | Dynamic, vivid |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "stolen my heart" — natural English, captures the overwhelming quality.

**Status:** All resolved.
